xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF for GitHub issue #4067: bind N>=3 panel seat families at dispatch and CLI-spawn other families on Grok Build.

plan.title: bug(design-critique): N=3 panel dispatch does not bind cross-family seats, and a Grok parent with claude/codex CLIs still paste-readies

narratives.Description: Bind seat families at N>=3 dispatch, refuse same-family lean, CLI-spawn Claude/Codex on PATH from a Grok Build parent, and offer or file a prevention issue after a composition miss.
narratives.Origin: Ingested from https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4067. Operator yolo 2026-09-01: without touching local arc yolo issue 4066; named issue 4067 through-merge in isolated worktree.
narratives.Overview: Two parent-dispatch errors on the #4066 yolo arc. N=3 spend recorded three xAI Grok spawn_subagent seats; isolation is not Decorrelation. After correction the parent paste-readied Claude and Codex while claude.cmd and codex.cmd were on PATH. The parent did not offer to file this prevention issue. Not a duplicate of #3962, #4035, #3815, #3578, or #4066. Non-goals: slug-classifier family detection, auto-dispatch without an operator verb, weakening isolation or id-ceiling, requiring three physical products when one host has three CLIs. Prefer one fail-closed helper over claimed families plus PATH probe results (#3265). Do not invent a live sibling-count gate (#3850). Keep panel-deposit round:/siblings:/input-ceiling:. Thin skill stays a pointer under the 80-line cap; edit pack source then packs:render.
narratives.UserStory: As the operator of a Grok Build N>=3 design-critique panel, I want seat families named before spawn and other-family CLIs used when they are on PATH, so the panel is not three correlated Grok seats and I am not asked to paste into other tabs.
narratives.When: When spend is N>=3, the parent records three claimed families before the first sibling spawn; a same-family set cannot be leaned; a Grok parent with claude and codex on PATH CLI-spawns those seats; a composition miss offers or files a prevention issue.
narratives.LockedDecisions: Parent claims family at dispatch; do not classify slugs. Paste-ready remains fallback only when a named family's CLI is absent. evaluateCompletedArcRecord still reads deposit as in-flight evidence only. Skill line cap 80. Pack source then packs:render. YOLO files the prevention issue; otherwise offer.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Extend Envelope and ceiling: families on panel-deposit or sibling-seat record; same-family no-lean with re-seat recovery; Grok Build launcher tree; miss-file-issue. Keep canonical round/siblings/input-ceiling block. 2. Brief template fields plus launcher probe pointer. 3. Thin skill pointers via pack source then task packs:render. 4. evaluatePanelSeatComposition helper over claimed families and PATH probe; refuse same-family and paste-ready-first when claude/codex resolve. 5. Content-contract pins. 6. Playbook/host-grok-build pointer only. 7. CHANGELOG [Unreleased].
narratives.NonGoals: Slug-classifier family detection (ADR-005 trap). Auto-dispatch without an operator verb (#3578). Weakening isolation or id-ceiling. Requiring three physical products. Live GitHub sibling-count observer (#3850).

items.title: N>=3 panel-deposit or sibling-seat record names three claimed families before spawn

narrative.When: When a parent posts a panel-deposit for spend N>=3, the durable record names three claimed families before the first sibling spawn.
narrative.Acceptance: content/contracts/design-critique.md requires the panel-deposit or a sibling-seat record to name three families before spawn. Canonical block still has round:, siblings:, and input-ceiling:. Families append after those fields.

items.title: Same-family sibling set cannot be leaned; printed recovery is re-seat, not wait for Stop 5

narrative.When: When claimed families on an N>=3 sibling set are not three distinct families, parent does not lean.
narrative.Acceptance: Contract forbids leaning a same-family sibling set. Printed recovery is re-seat or halt, not wait for Stop 5 Decorrelation.

items.title: Grok Build parent with claude and codex on PATH CLI-spawns those seats; paste-ready is not the default recovery

narrative.When: When the parent is Grok Build and claude/codex resolve on PATH, those are the other-family launchers.
narrative.Acceptance: Contract launcher tree: Grok via spawn_subagent or grok; Claude via claude CLI; Codex via codex exec. Paste-ready only when a named family's CLI is absent. Probe before offering paste. Close stdin on CLI spawns.

items.title: Fail-closed helper refuses same-family panels and paste-ready-first when claude/codex resolve

narrative.When: When claimed families plus PATH probe results are evaluated, same-family N>=3 and paste-ready-first with CLIs present fail closed.
narrative.Acceptance: evaluatePanelSeatComposition, given claimed families and PATH probe results, refuses same-family panels (remediation re-seat) and refuses paste-ready-first when claude/codex resolve. Fixture: Grok parent + PATH claude/codex is not paste-ready-first. Not a live GitHub observer.

items.title: Dispatch-composition miss offers or files a prevention issue (yolo files)

narrative.When: After a seat-composition or launcher miss, parent does not only re-seat.
narrative.Acceptance: Contract requires offering a prevention issue, and filing it on yolo. Thin skill points; does not copy the rule body.

items.title: Thin skill pointers via pack source then packs:render; line cap 80; required pointers remain

narrative.When: When the design-critique skill is rendered, it stays a thin pointer under 80 lines.
narrative.Acceptance: Edit content/packs/skills/skills-pack-0.1.json then task packs:render. SKILL.md line count <= 80. Required skill pointers remain. No contract bodies copied.

items.title: Content-contract tests lock new tokens; existing panel-deposit regex stays in sync

narrative.When: When design_critique_contract.test.ts runs, new family/launcher/miss tokens are pinned and the canonical deposit block still matches.
narrative.Acceptance: packages/core/src/content-contracts/standards/design_critique_contract.test.ts locks new contract tokens. Existing panel-deposit regex for round:/siblings:/input-ceiling: still passes.

narrative.When: When CHANGELOG [Unreleased] is read, it records the seat-family and launcher bind.
narrative.Acceptance: CHANGELOG [Unreleased] has a brief release-notes entry that closes #4067.
